title: Functions
preview: Define functions, classify linear vs non-linear, compare functions across representations, and read function tables.
description: Students develop the formal definition of a function, recognise functions across tables, graphs, equations, and verbal descriptions, and compare rates of change across representations.

sections.label: 6-1 What is a Function?
sections.description: One-output-per-input. Recognise functions across multiple representations.

sections.label: 6-2 Linear vs Non-Linear Functions
sections.description: Test for linearity in tables and equations; classify common non-linear shapes.

sections.label: 6-3 Comparing Functions Across Representations
sections.description: Translate among equations, tables, and graphs to compare rates.

sections.label: 6-4 Functions from Tables (Reading and Filling)
sections.description: Read a function table, infer the rule, and predict outputs.
